data.title: Express Entry: Federal Skilled Worker Program
data.content:
## Minimum requirements

You must meet all the minimum requirements in these areas:

*   skilled work experience
*   language ability
*   education

### Skilled work experience

Your work experience must be at least 1 year continuous full-time or the equal amount in part-time work (1,560 hours).

We don't count any hours you work above 30 hours/week.

### Language ability

You must meet the minimum score of Canadian Language Benchmark (CLB) 7 in all 4 abilities.

### Proof of funds

You must show that you have enough money to support yourself and your family after you get to Canada unless you are currently authorized to work in Canada and have a valid job offer.
